title: Normalized scalar composition is uniqueness of left adjoints
statement: For composable ring-sheaf maps f:R→S and g:S→V on a small site, let af, ag and ah be adjunctions for the specified derived extension and restriction functors of f, g and f≫g, respectively. Suppose their units are the specified normalized adicFiniteUnit maps of [lem-sfb-adic-finite-reduction-data]. Compose af and ag and transport its right adjoint by adicFiniteDresComp(f,g). Its uniqueness comparison with ah equals the scalar-composition isomorphism specified by adicFiniteExtendComp_existsUnique(f,g).

source.place: Tag 03CZ, tensor/restriction adjunction; sites-cohomology.tex, Tag 06YY, K-flat derived scalar extension and composition.

proof.text: On a K-flat representative, the normalized derived unit computes the derived Hom equivalence as localization of the ordinary tensor/restriction Hom equivalence followed by resFactors. This follows by the unit formula and naturality of resFactors.

Apply that formula successively for f and g; scalar extension preserves K-flatness. The exact-restriction compositor respects resFactors. The ordinary composite unit is insertion of one for f≫g, because ordinary balancing sends 1 tensor (1 tensor x) to 1 tensor x. Naturality of restriction composition moves ordinary balancing to the final position. Thus the uniqueness comparison of the composed adjunction satisfies the normalization defining derived scalar balancing.
Apply the uniqueness clause of adicFiniteExtendComp_existsUnique to identify these two isomorphisms.

proof_origin.place: Tag 06YY; combine the specified K-flat computation normalization with uniqueness of adjoints and the ordinary adjunction in Tag 03CZ.

lean.statement:
theorem adicFiniteExtendComp_leftAdjointUniq (f : R ⟶ S) (g : S ⟶ V)
    (af : extend f ⊣ dres f) (ag : extend g ⊣ dres g)
    (ah : extend (f ≫ g) ⊣ dres (f ≫ g))
    (hf : af.unit = adicFiniteUnit f) (hg : ag.unit = adicFiniteUnit g)
    (hh : ah.unit = adicFiniteUnit (f ≫ g)) :
    ((af.comp ag).ofNatIsoRight (adicFiniteDresComp f g)).leftAdjointUniq ah =
      (adicFiniteExtendComp_existsUnique f g).exists.choose
